checks.description: Marketing language, empty phrases ('it should be noted that', 'powerful', 'seamless', 'robust', 'leverage', 'utilize').
TODOs, {placeholder} tokens, TBD, leftover template comments (<!-- PURPOSE:, <!-- EXAMPLE:, <!-- AUDIENCE:), lorem ipsum.
Content doesn't deliver what the heading promises. A heading says 'Configuration' but the section only lists file paths with no configuration instructions.
'see below', 'as described above', 'the following section' where the referenced target doesn't exist in the document.
Conflicting statements within the same document (e.g., 'requires Python 3.10+' in one section, 'works with Python 3.8+' in another).
Code block with no preceding or following explanation of what it does or when to use it.
Column count mismatches between header and rows, unexplained empty cells, tables with only a header and no rows.
Technical terms (API, JSON, schema, env var, runtime, endpoint, payload) used without a plain-language definition or link to glossary.
Procedure/how-to with no success confirmation at the end -- user completes steps but doesn't know if it worked.
Database table names, file paths, function names, class names exposed to end users who don't need them.
Procedural section starts with steps (numbered list) but has no goal/purpose statement explaining WHY to follow these steps.
Architecture described generically ('the service processes requests') without naming specific files, functions, or classes.
API signatures, function descriptions, or parameter lists without parameter types or return types.
Design decision or architectural choice presented without alternatives considered or rationale for why this approach was chosen.
Uses 'should', 'typically', 'usually', 'generally' where MUST/MUST NOT is intended. Agent docs need unambiguous constraints.
Convention rules or constraints without incorrect counter-examples showing what NOT to do.
Gotchas, constraints, or rules without a 'what breaks if violated' explanation.
Bash/shell command with no expected output shown -- operator can't verify the command succeeded.
Change, deploy, or migration procedure with no rollback steps or recovery guidance.
Commands containing <placeholder> tokens without substitution guidance explaining what value to use.
OVERVIEW audience guide table is missing an audience that has generated documentation in the docs directory.

Content contradicts its declared <!-- DIATAXIS: type --> classification. Reference docs with step-by-step instructions, how-to with lengthy rationale, tutorials as API tables, explanations with imperative commands.
Internal markdown links ([text](path)) where the target file or heading does not exist. Resolve relative links from the original doc location, not chunk path.
